title: Render Window Hotkeys
content: The window can be found under the title bar menu, Edit -> Render Window Hotkeys Editor Window: File:Render Window Hotkeys.png - Filter: Filters the hotkey list using the given text. - Hotkey Alt: The hotkey uses the Alt key press. Control: The hotkey uses the Control key press. Shift: The hotkey uses the Shift key press. Assign: Assigns the hotkey to the selected key presses. Revert: Reverts the hotkey to its default key press. See Also: - Render Window - Editor Interface
